name: check_room
description: Checks if a study room can be booked for the requested time. All times are whole minutes since midnight, from 0 to 1440 (for example 10:00 is 600 and 24:00 is 1440). The tool only checks and answers Available or Unavailable. It does not save, create or change any booking.

start.description: Requested start time in minutes since midnight, 0 to 1440.

end.description: Requested end time in minutes since midnight, 0 to 1440.

now.description: The current time in minutes since midnight, 0 to 1440.

blocked.description: true if the room is blocked, for example for maintenance.

bookings.description: Existing bookings of the room. Can be empty.
